$comment: Findings check-org-sentinel-reads.mjs knows about and does not fail on.
This RATCHETS DOWN and cannot rot: an entry that matches no finding is
itself an error, so the file cannot outlive the defect it waives. Add an
entry only for a live instance whose fix belongs to a different change,
and name that change in `fixedBy` so the entry has an owner and an end.
Never add one to make your own diff pass.

waived.reason: Live instance in the Mission Control rebuild, inherited from the base and not introduced here. The `org.apiKeys` port takes an OrgCtx, so `capabilityContext` in apps/app/src/server/kernel.ts hands list_api_keys the org-only sentinel, and its handler reads auth.api_keys (policy class `standard`) through withTenantDb — so the organization API-keys page is answered no keys at all. Found by the pass that models the kernelRead seam, which was added in this change after a review pointed out the checker could not see the rebuild's architecture at all.
waived.fixedBy: #3116 (ADR-073), which splits the port by scope: apiKeys(ctx: WsCtx). Verified against that branch — the finding is absent there, and this entry will fail as stale the moment it merges.
